title: Beasts of Amberfield
text:
Old Rendclaw has a lair of his own, Grimmaw moves like a six-legged beast, and every hero's skin bends cleanly.

✨ Old Rendclaw now has his own lair in a quiet corner of Amberfield, well away from the roads, the town and other creatures
⬆️ Grimmaw walks on alternating tripods of legs with his body rising and falling, breathes and works his jaws while idle, rears up to bite and rakes with his front claws
🔧 Grimmaw now faces the way he is moving instead of walking backwards
⬆️ Smoother skin on every hero: weights were blended across the whole body so shoulders, hips, knees and robes bend without stretching or dragging
🔧 Fewer stray triangles stretching between arms, legs and the body during runs, attacks and dances
